mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a short-term sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a weakening demand cycle, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as recessionary pressures build, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Fed to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high housing starts, the S&P 500 tends to experience short-term pullbacks as overvaluation risks emerge, leading to negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
